entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Customer Service'.
Customer Service.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, this is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. My order number is VF789012.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me pull up order VF789012... I see a VeloBand Pulse that was delivered 12 days ago. Is that the item?
Yes, the VeloBand Pulse. It's just not what I expected. I want to send it back.
I understand. Okay, I see it was delivered on the 14th. You're well within our 90-day return policy, so we can definitely get that started for you... Oh, **wait actually**, **let me correct myself**.
What? What do you mean?

My apologies, I **misspoke**. I was looking at our standard policy for apparel and accessories. Because the VeloBand Pulse is a health and electronics device, it has a different policy. The return window for that specific item is **10 days**.
Ten days? Are you serious? It's been twelve! That's insane. No one told me it was only 10 days. I just got around to opening it yesterday.

I completely understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for my initial error causing that confusion. The 10-day policy is in place for electronic wearables due to health and data security reasons. Since you are two days past that window, I can't process a standard refund to your credit card.
So that's it? I'm just stuck with a $150 piece of plastic I don't want because of two days? This is unacceptable.
I understand your position. While a refund to the original payment method isn't possible, let me see what I can do for you. I see you've been a VeloFit customer for a few years. One moment please.
Thank you for your patience. As a one-time exception, what I can offer is a full store credit for the purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. You could use that towards any other gear on our site.
A store credit for the full amount?
Yes, and for the confusion I caused when I misspoke earlier, I'd also like to add a $25 courtesy credit to your account. You'll have that full amount available immediately.
Oh. Wow. Okay. So I'll get the full value back plus extra? I was actually looking at one of your new cycling computers. That would cover a good chunk of it.

Exactly. I'm applying the credit to your account right now. You should receive an email confirmation with the details in the next few minutes. Would you still like instructions on how to send the VeloBand back to us?
Yeah, please. This is actually a great solution. Thank you for sorting this out. I was getting pretty mad there for a second.
Of course, I'm happy we could find a solution that works for you. I'm sending the return label to your email now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex. You really helped me out.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
